data_gap.note_zh: 本图层刻意保持空集合。控规控制线（容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度、绿地率、退线、道路红线与建筑控制线）、文物保护范围与建设控制地带、土地权属地块、现状主干路与快速路、轨道与蓝线均属锁定图层，公开场地包中没有可引用的官方几何来源。缺口按 A-CONTROLS-001 与 A-BOUNDARY-002 登记；在取得官方或已清权几何之前，不得以推定线条冒充 official_constraint——空集合优于编造。官方几何入库后须重跑几何生成、指标复算、图件与展示页并刷新 manifest 哈希。
data_gap.note_en: This layer is intentionally an empty set. Regulatory control lines (FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines and building control lines), heritage protection and construction-control zones, cadastral parcels, existing arterial and express roads, rail and blue lines are locked layers with no citable official geometry in the public site package. The gap is registered as A-CONTROLS-001 and A-BOUNDARY-002; until official or cleared geometry is available, inferred lines must not be presented as official_constraint, because an empty set is preferable to fabrication. Once official geometry is published, regenerate geometry, metrics, figures, drawings and the HTML page, then refresh manifest hashes.
